title: The harness release candidate: every verify layer, broken alone
note: Killed in digests mode (no signature runtime needed): each layer beneath SHA256SUMS has a forgery consistent everywhere else (tests/test_supply_chain.py), so a deleted check cannot hide behind the one above it. Signature verification itself runs in the supply-chain workflow, with GitHub OIDC. SC12-SC19 attack the archive checks added for D-2026-127: each member was compared with the commit but not the commit with the members, and nothing compared the signed archive with the manifest it carries.

mutations.name: SC1_bytes_need_not_match_the_sums
mutations.rationale: an artifact whose bytes changed after signing verifies

mutations.name: SC2_the_sums_may_list_anything
mutations.rationale: SHA256SUMS can sign a different set of files from the one the release is

mutations.name: SC3_provenance_subjects_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the provenance can describe other bytes than the ones signed

mutations.name: SC4_the_source_commit_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: provenance and index can name different commits

mutations.name: SC5_the_index_digests_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the index can state a digest the signature never covered

mutations.name: SC6_the_sbom_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: an SBOM that adds or drops a locked package verifies

mutations.name: SC7_source_members_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: source.zip can carry a file the commit does not have

mutations.name: SC8_the_manifest_digest_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the index can name a manifest digest other than the archived manifest's

mutations.name: SC9_a_missing_signature_is_skipped
mutations.rationale: a required signature that is absent is not refused as absent

mutations.name: SC10_a_wildcard_policy_is_accepted
mutations.find: if not isinstance(v, str) or not v or "*" in v or "PENDING" in v:
mutations.replace: if not isinstance(v, str) or not v:
mutations.rationale: a wildcard signer identity verifies anyone's signature

mutations.name: SC11_any_issuer_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: a signature from an identity provider other than GitHub Actions' verifies

mutations.name: SC12_the_archive_need_not_hold_the_whole_commit
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: only members outside the commit are refused; an archive that lost files verifies as MATCHES

mutations.name: SC13_the_manifest_may_list_files_the_archive_lacks
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: a signed archive missing files its own manifest lists is accepted

mutations.name: SC14_members_the_manifest_does_not_list_are_accepted
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: the archive carries files outside the release its manifest describes

mutations.name: SC15_the_archive_bytes_are_not_compared_with_the_manifest
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: the manifest describes other bytes than the ones that were signed

mutations.name: SC16_the_detached_manifest_hash_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: manifest_hash.txt may name another manifest than the one beside it

mutations.name: SC17_a_member_may_be_named_twice
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: two copies of one path, and the extractor picks which is the release

mutations.name: SC18_the_member_count_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: the index's file count is printed and never checked

mutations.name: SC19_verify_never_reads_the_archived_manifest
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: the whole layer removed; the signature binds an archive nobody compared with what it says it is

mutations.name: SC20_an_empty_manifest_describes_any_archive
mutations.rationale: D-2026-127: without a checkout, an archive holding only the detached files verifies -- every per-file comparison passes over zero files
